worker_claim.report: The implementation is complete. Python compilation, diff checks, capability probing, and an end-to-end cgroup spawn/force-terminate/destroy smoke test passed; the repository test runner and Ruff were unavailable because the local .venv/tools are not installed.
worker_claim.summary: Implemented Linux execution ownership with per-execution cgroup v2 boundaries, pre-exec cgroup joining, kernel-population retirement proof, and recursive forced termination. Removed sampled /proc descendant tracking from worker ownership logic, added capability probing and fail-closed admission, enabled systemd subtree delegation, and documented equivalent non-systemd provisioning.
